==Overview==
As wildlife creatures with quills grown on them. Quillbeasts are known for their clumsy yet damaging abilities that makes them a decent threat:

*Claws twice in a row, dealing Physical damage.
*Swings their tail around, dealing Physical damage and knock Operators back. This is followed with a tail slam, dealing Physical damage and knock Operators back at front.
*Bounce around three times, dealing Physical damage and knock Operators back. This ability can be interrupted by skills.
*Enters Enraged state and rush forward before ending with a fall, dealing Physical damage and knock Operators back. This ability can be interrupted by skills.
